messages:
mike: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's autoscale spike. Capturing owners/timelines here so we don't lose momentum.

mike: TL;DR: quota exhaustion in us-west hit Dedicated pool, scheduler preemption jitter caused pod shuffling, headroom dipped below 8% -> cascading retries. Estimated user-facing impact ~25m.

anya: ack. can you paste the postmortem link?

mike: https://redwood.internal/pm/3315-autoscale-spike -- main doc has timeline + logs.

jen: main action items I see: 1) quota request to cloud (reserve +20 GPUs) 2) scheduler tuning: lengthen preemption window and reduce aggressive eviction scoring 3) headroom guardrails: set a per-zone min of 10% free capacity + alerting.

raman: I can own scheduler tuning. Plan: validate change in dev, then canary to 10% of us-west nodes. ETA: EOD tomorrow for PR and canary run.

mike: assigning owners here so we have clear ownership: quota request -> liz, scheduler tuning -> raman, headroom policy + dashboard -> jen, synthetic load tests -> anya.

liz: copying billing/cloud contacts now. I'll file the quota ticket today and request expedited review. ETA 48h unless cloud ops flag as urgent. Ticket: CLOUD-5543.

sre-bot: Reminder: incident task INC-2026 created and linked to this thread.

anya: also adding a requirement to run a synthetic burst test after changes (10x traffic) to validate no regressions.

raman: canary plan: change preemption window to 30s in dev; if stable, roll to 10% of us-west capacity. Monitor eviction rate, tail P95 latency, and pod restart counts for 2 hours. Rollback if >5% error delta or eviction spike.

jen: i'll add a dashboard card and alert: headroom <12% for 5m -> page on-call. Also add an SLO check for sustained queuing latency.

mike: timeline recap: liz files quota request today, raman posts PR + canary tomorrow, full rollout conditional week-of. jen to publish dashboard and set alert thresholds before canary. anya to run loadtest post-canary. I'll own the action-tracking sheet and weekly check-ins.

liz: CLOUD-5543 filed, linked this slack thread and pm doc, asked for expedited review. Pinged @cloud-ops contact (see ticket).

anya: here's the script for synthetic burst test — copy to run after scheduler canary:

```bash
# run 10x burst against us-west dedicated pool
python infra/loadtest.py --region us-west --concurrency 500 --duration 600 --target dedicated
```

raman: i'll also dump k8s scheduler traces and post to the PM doc after the canary. ETA 24h after canary start.

jen: can we add a column to the spreadsheet for "recurring pattern?" I noticed similar spikes roughly every 3 weeks in the logs; we should track recurrence and link prior incidents.

mike: good call. I'll include recurrence and link previous incident IDs. Action tracking format: (action, owner, due, status, PR/ticket, prior incidents). I'll post the sheet in this channel when done.

sre-bot: Note: follow-up coordination meeting scheduled for 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC. Agenda channel: #incidents.

mike: thanks everyone. Please update the spreadsheet as you make progress. Mark items resolved here when done and we'll close the follow-up thread once all actions are complete. :thumbsup:
